d: Mountains of Aragon. I saw in the distance the Moorish castle of Don Ruy Gomez de Silva. It is at sunset. Chorus of Mountain Rebellions and Bandits. Eat and drink: part plays, and part sets weapons.
Ernani who mesto shows up from a summit, and sayings.
Rich rooms of Elvira in the castle of Silva. It is night. Elvira is alone.
Detta and Ancelle, who come in carrying rich wedding gifts.
Carlo and Giovanna.
Carlo.
Dettalo and Elvira.
Said and Ernani that comes from a secret exit and goes to stand between them.
Said and Silva, followed by his Knights and Joan with the Handmaids. Charles will be so that he will not be easily recognized by Silva. Elvira tries to recompose, and hides the dagger.
Say, Jago and Don Riccardo.

Magnificent room in the palace of Don Ruy Gomez de Silva. Doors that put to various apartments. Around the veggon walls arranged, within rich frames, surmounted by ducal crowns and golden coats of arms, the portraits of the Silva family. At each portrait there is a complete equestrian armor, corresponding to the time when the painted character lived. Start also a rich table with a ducal oak high chair. Knights and Paggi of Don Ruy, Dames and Damigelle of Elvira richly dressed.
Said, Jago, and Silva, who pompously dressed as a grown-up of Spain, goes to sit on the ducal high chair.
The door to Elvira's apartment opens, and she enters into rich wedding dresses, followed by the young Paggi and Ancelle.
Elvira, Silva party, takes some steps to follow the Handmaids, then stops and, exit those, returns anxiously to Ernani, who disdainfully rejects her.
Said and Silva, that seeing them embraced, he threw himself furious at each other with a dagger in his hand.
Says and Jago hasty.
Silva, Elvira and Ernani.
Silva, Don Carlo, Don Riccardo with followers of Knights.
Don Carlo, Silva, Don Riccardo and part of the Knights.
Knights returning carrying arms bundles, and sayings.
Elvira that comes out of her rooms precipitously followed by Joan and Annels, and sayings.
Silva.
Said and Ernani.
The Knights of Silva enter unarmed and hastily.

To the right of the spectator starts the monument with bronze doors, above which the inscription "KAROLO MAGNO" can be read in cubic letters: at the bottom of the stairway that places at the main door of the basement, in which there will be other minor tombs; on the floor of the scene other doors leading to other catacombs. Two hanging lamps from the middle spread a dim light on those Avelli. Don Carlo and Don Riccardo wrapped in large dark coats enter guarding from the main door. Don Riccardo precedes with a torch. Carlo, Riccardo.
Carlo.
I unlocked the lower doors of the basement, and the characters of the league carrying torches enter it, guarding and wrapped in great robes.
Say, Silva, Ernani and Jago dressed like the first.
Says and don Carlo from the door of the monument.

The great door of the basement opens, and at the trumpet ringing six Electors come in dressed in gold brocade followed by Paggi carrying over velvet cushions the scepter, the crown and other imperial insignia. Rich procession of Gentiluomini and Dame Alemanne and Spanish surround the emperor. Among the last seen Elvira followed by Giovanna. In the bottom will be explained the flags of the empire, and many torches brought by 'Soldati will illuminate the scene. Don Riccardo is at the head of the court.

Terrace in the palace of Don Giovanni d'Aragona in Zaragoza. To the right and to the left are several doors that put to various apartments; the bottom is closed by gates, through which I see the gardens of the illuminated palace and part of Zaragoza. At the bottom, to the right of the spectator, he starts a large staircase that goes into the gardens. From a room to the left of those who watched I heard the happy music of the dances. Gentlemen, Dames, Masks, Paggi and Ancelle go and they come gaily chatting with each other.
A Mask appears all closed in black dominated, looking eagerly around, as he who seeks with care any.
More Masks come from the ballroom.
Elvira and Ernani come from the ballroom, going to the right of the spectator, where is the wedding room.
Ernani.
Said and Silva masked.
Said and Elvira from the wedding rooms.
